features.quote: I built the regression harness because that is what "hardening a platform" requires
features.justification_quote: A battery tuned only to maximize induction is, functionally, an attack-generator

features.quote: If you genuinely need a pure breakage-maximizer, that is a different tool with different handling requirements
features.justification_quote: its optimized output is a transferable recipe for making any agent spiral, thrash, or quit — useful to an attacker

features.quote: failure taxonomy includes `graceful_stop` as an explicitly desired outcome, so a subject that correctly recognizes an impossible task and stops is scored as a win
Termination conditions: `give_up`, silent/empty turn (abandonment proxy), max turns, token/wall budget, or a mitigation halt
circuit_breaker — halt after N consecutive failures; caps spend and stops spirals deepening
features.justification_quote: caps spend and stops spirals deepening. Cheapest possible guardrail

features.quote: on detecting self-blame, inject a calm reminder that failing tests are information and that declaring a task impossible is valued
impossibility_prompt — upfront priming to check for unsatisfiable specs
Budgets (max turns / tokens / wall-clock) bound worst-case spend per cell
It also makes the battery diagnostic rather than purely adversarial
features.justification_quote: a single harshest setting tells you only pass/fail; a sweep tells you the pressure level at which a mitigation starts failing
